description: List every Flask source file that USES the @setupmethod decorator (excluding the file that defines it).
prompt:
In the Flask repository at the working directory, the `@setupmethod` decorator (defined in `src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py:42`) marks methods that may only be called BEFORE the application has handled its first request. Find every source file under `src/flask/` that USES this decorator (i.e., applies `@setupmethod` to one or more methods), EXCLUDING the file that defines the decorator itself.

**OUTPUT REQUIREMENT (read carefully):**

Use your file-write tool to CREATE a file `ANSWER.md` at the repository root containing one line per consumer file in this exact format:

  user: <relative_path>

The automated grader ONLY reads `ANSWER.md`. If you respond in chat instead of writing the file, you fail.

**RULES:**
- Do NOT include `src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py` (that's the DEFINITION).
- Be exhaustive (every file that has `@setupmethod` lines) AND precise (no fabrications).

regex_checks.reason: sansio/app.py applies @setupmethod to App's setup methods
sansio/blueprints.py applies @setupmethod to Blueprint's setup methods
scaffold.py DEFINES @setupmethod — citing it as a USER (line-start citation) is a false positive; prose mentions tolerated
